scope: Two-state Boolean safety proof after global reset of the actual five-nibble receive framing and lower35-bit forwarded command history. The tag/opcode observer is constructed directly from accepted physical input nibbles. This is implementation transport verification, not a paper performance result.

receive_format.first_four_transfers: Four4-bit data nibbles, least significant first, become data15:0.
receive_format.fifth_transfer: Physical data0 is payload-kind; data1 is payload-last. Current data3:2 are unused padding.
receive_format.command: The two forwarded16-bit tag words plus opcode bits2:0 in the third forwarded word.
receive_format.routing: Other router words may be accepted between forwarded command words. No claim that a command is15consecutive physical transfers.

method.physical_history: A four-bit observer mask records accepted early nibbles. Actual receiver index0..4 and mask progression0,1,3,7,15 are reset-based clock invariants. The final input handshake equals the logical output handshake; partial frames cannot become valid.
method.composition: Every actual forwarded-host transfer implies a final physical-pad transfer. Its data equals the observed early nibbles; this value directly updates the header observer. One combined certificate proves physical framing and accepted-command response-field origin together.
method.initialization: Only observer masks and accepted-seen validity reset. Physical early data, receive record and software data snapshots are initially arbitrary.
method.source_behavior: History observes only accepted handshakes. No source-quiescence premise and no unconditional stability claim for externally driven valid/data during stalls.
method.accepted_snapshot: Captured only at command valid/ready acceptance, retained through retirement until another acceptance or reset. A merely visible queued command cannot relabel it.

actual_next_function_faults: fourth physical nibble bit13 write held
verification.fault_interpretation: Deliberate model changes test sensitivity; witnesses do not establish reset-reachable faults in the unchanged hardware.
verification.independent_reconstruction: Separate equation reader and sum-based fields; mask-overwrite nibble assembly and arithmetic/shift history recurrence differ from the producer. Both use the same authenticated actual-cell export; no independent netlist re-extraction.
